data.gender_notes: Elisha is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Elisha is derived from the Hebrew word 'el' meaning 'God' and 'yasha' meaning 'to save'. In the Bible, Elisha was a prophet and a successor to Elijah. His name symbolizes God's saving power and his dedication to serving and following God. The name Elisha carries the meaning “My God is salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Elisha usually hope their child will grow to embody my god is salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents trust and faith in God's saving power.
data.etymology: Elisha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My God is salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elisha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
